step-demo-basic.text: This step is called the basic step.

Break on two, transfer the weight
completely, and come back on six.

The most important detail is the weight
transfer.

Do not rush it, and keep the supporting
knee soft.
Let us do it slowly with the counts.

One, two, three, four, five, six, seven,
eight.

One, two, three, four, five, six, seven,
eight.
Now with the music. Here we go.

step-demo-weight.text:
Break on two, transfer the weight
completely, and come back on six.

The most important detail is the weight
transfer.

Do not rush it, and keep the supporting
knee soft.

step-demo-suzieq.text: This one is called the Suzie Q.
Cross in front, open, and cross again.

Keep the knees soft and rotate from the
torso, not from the arms.

A common mistake is lifting the heel too
early.

Keep the heel down until the weight
arrives.
Keep the pressure into the floor.

step-demo-combo1.text:
Now let us put it together into a small
combination.

We start with the basic step, then two
Suzie Qs, and we finish with a right turn.

The turn preparation happens on six, so do
not be late.

Full combination with the music. Here we
go.
